description: Add CLOB API trades client with L2 auth and timestamp-based pagination for unlimited historical trade fetching
steps: Add CLOB API base URL constant (https://clob.polymarket.com) to client.py
Add Polymarket CLOB/L2 auth settings to config.py (POLYGON_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_KEY, POLYMARKET_BUILDER_SECRET, POLYMARKET_BUILDER_PASSPHRASE)
Implement PolymarketClobClient class with L2 auth header generation using py-clob-client or manual HMAC
Implement fetch_clob_trades() using GET /data/trades with before/after Unix timestamp params
Paginate by walking backwards: use oldest match_time from each batch as next 'before' param until 'after' boundary reached
Add configurable rate limiting (sleep between pages) to respect CLOB API limits
Add unit tests for CLOB client pagination logic with mocked responses

description: Add CLOB-based trades ingestion function for backfill use case
steps: Add ingest_trades_clob() async function to polymarket/ingest.py
Compute day boundaries (start-of-day and end-of-day UTC) from --dt param as Unix timestamps
Use PolymarketClobClient.fetch_clob_trades(after=start_ts, before=end_ts) to fetch all trades for that day
Upload to S3 with correct key structure: bronze/polymarket/trades/dt={date}/run_id={uuid}/
Generate manifest with api_base_url pointing to CLOB endpoint
Add run_ingest_trades_clob() synchronous wrapper for CLI usage

description: Add backfill CLI command that iterates over date ranges for all platforms and entities
steps: Add 'backfill' command group to CLI app in main.py
Implement backfill command with options: --platform (polymarket|kalshi|all), --entity (trades|markets|events|all), --start-date, --end-date, --bucket
Add --dry-run flag to preview planned ingestion runs without executing
Iterate day-by-day from start-date to end-date, running appropriate ingestion function per day
For Polymarket trades: use existing ingest_trades() (CLOB client deferred to separate feature)
For Kalshi trades: use existing ingest_trades() with min_ts/max_ts set to day boundaries
For markets/events on both platforms: run existing snapshot ingestion per day
Log progress per day and continue on failure, printing summary of failed days at end
Add --concurrency option to control parallel day processing (default: 1 sequential) [DEFERRED - sequential only for now]

Document rate limits for Polymarket CLOB API and Kalshi API
Document required environment variables for backfill (POLYGON_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, POLYMARKET_BUILDER_* vars)

Add unit tests for backfill date range iteration logic
Add unit tests for backfill CLI command (validation, dry-run, orchestration, error handling)

Add integration test for single-day Kalshi trades backfill with min_ts/max_ts
Add end-to-end test: backfill 3-day range for all entities on both platforms
